aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profiles_list
aliasModeTools.description: List AliasMode profiles, their proxy host:port (never credentials) and current browser state. Cloud profiles include expectedVersion and permission for editing.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profiles_replace_proxies
aliasModeTools.description: Dry-run or apply bulk proxy replacements to closed AliasMode Cloud profiles. Apply always preflights first.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_create
aliasModeTools.description: Create a persistent AliasMode profile, or an explicit temporary profile. Without engine, Windows creates an AliasMode Chromium profile, and macOS and Linux create an AliasMode Firefox profile.

chromiumRuntime.description: Chromium profiles only. aliasmode (AliasMode Chromium 155) is the default where this computer can run it. CloakBrowser profiles on one computer can be linked to each other.

proxyFrom.description: Copy the proxy of this profile ID (credentials included) instead of passing proxy

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_update
aliasModeTools.description: Edit a closed AliasMode profile by ID. Cloud profiles need expectedVersion from aliasmode_profiles_list. Only supplied fields change; empty strings clear fields. Sessions and cookies are preserved. Returns confirmation, not credentials.

proxyFrom.description: Copy the proxy of this profile ID (credentials included) instead of set.proxy

proxy.description: host:port:user:pass, or an empty string to remove the proxy

blockMedia.description: Block images to save proxy traffic (Firefox profiles also stop video autoplay). Takes effect at next open.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_delete
aliasModeTools.description: Move a closed AliasMode profile to Trash. Only the user can empty Trash.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_new_identity
aliasModeTools.description: Give an AliasMode profile a new identity, like Mullvad Browser's New Identity: delete its whole browser data on this computer (cookies, logins, history, bookmarks, saved passwords, site data and add-ons installed inside the browser) and give it a new fingerprint on the same system and browser. Name, folder, proxy, login details, tags and extensions assigned in AliasMode stay. An open profile is closed and opened again. There is no undo.

annotations.title: Start a new identity for an AliasMode profile

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_open
aliasModeTools.description: Open an AliasMode browser and select it for Playwright actions.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_select
aliasModeTools.description: Select an open AliasMode browser for subsequent Playwright actions.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_status
aliasModeTools.description: Get the selected browser state, or the state of one profile.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_close
aliasModeTools.description: Safely capture and close one AliasMode browser.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_list
aliasModeTools.description: List the user's Script Library scripts (id, name, language, description; never source code). Use an id with aliasmode_scripts_run.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_get
aliasModeTools.description: Read one Script Library script: its metadata, revision and full source code. Use it before changing a script.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_save
aliasModeTools.description: Create a script in the user's own Script Library, or update one by passing its scriptId. On update, omitted fields keep their current value; source replaces the whole file. JavaScript scripts export a default async function receiving { browser, context, page, profile, inputs, credentials, log }; Python scripts define async def run(...) with the same names. Read an existing script first to match its shape.

scriptId.description: Omit to create a new script.

expectedRevision.description: Revision you read; the save fails if the script changed since.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_run
aliasModeTools.description: Run a Script Library script on one or more profiles; AliasMode opens and closes each browser. Only one run can be active at a time, and a second request fails while one is running. Returns the run immediately: follow it with aliasmode_scripts_status and aliasmode_scripts_log.

inputs.description: JSON inputs passed to the script.

useCredentials.description: Give the script the saved login details of each profile. They are shown as *** in the status and log.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_status
aliasModeTools.description: Get the current or last script run: its id, status (running, stopping, finished) and the state of each profile. The run is null when none exists.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_log
aliasModeTools.description: Read the output log of a script run from a byte offset. Pass the nextOffset of the previous call to read only new output.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_stop
aliasModeTools.description: Stop the running script and close its browsers. Returns the final run state.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_scripts_on_open
aliasModeTools.description: Set the script that runs each time a profile is opened from the AliasMode app, or omit scriptId to clear it.

scriptId.description: Omit to clear the profile's run-on-open script.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_schedules_list
aliasModeTools.description: List script schedules (jobs with their next and last run), the recent schedule run history, and the run-on-open script of each profile.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_schedules_save
aliasModeTools.description: Create a schedule that runs a library script on profiles every few hours or daily at a set time, or update one by passing its scheduleId. On update, omitted fields keep their current value. Schedules run only while the AliasMode app is open.

scheduleId.description: Omit to create a new schedule.

everyHours.description: Run every this many hours. Set this or dailyAt.

dailyAt.description: Run daily at HH:MM in the computer's local time. Set this or everyHours.

inputs.description: JSON inputs passed to the script.

useCredentials.description: Give the script the saved login details of each profile. Off for a new schedule.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_schedules_delete
aliasModeTools.description: Delete a script schedule. The script itself stays in the library.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_close
aliasModeTools.description: Safely capture and close the selected AliasMode browser.

playwrightTools.name: browser_resize
playwrightTools.description: Resize the browser window

playwrightTools.name: browser_console_messages
playwrightTools.description: Returns all console messages

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

playwrightTools.name: browser_handle_dialog
playwrightTools.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

playwrightTools.name: browser_evaluate
playwrightTools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

playwrightTools.name: browser_file_upload
playwrightTools.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

playwrightTools.name: browser_fill_form
playwrightTools.description: Fill multiple form fields

ref.description: Exact target field reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

playwrightTools.name: browser_press_key
playwrightTools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

playwrightTools.name: browser_type
playwrightTools.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

playwrightTools.name: browser_navigate
playwrightTools.description: Navigate to a URL

playwrightTools.name: browser_navigate_back
playwrightTools.description: Go back to the previous page

playwrightTools.name: browser_network_requests
playwrightTools.description: Returns all network requests since loading the page

includeStatic.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

playwrightTools.name: browser_mouse_move_xy
playwrightTools.description: Move mouse to a given position

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

playwrightTools.name: browser_mouse_click_xy
playwrightTools.description: Click left mouse button at a given position

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

playwrightTools.name: browser_mouse_drag_xy
playwrightTools.description: Drag left mouse button to a given position

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

playwrightTools.name: browser_pdf_save
playwrightTools.description: Save page as PDF

filename.description: File name to save the pdf to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.pdf` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

playwrightTools.name: browser_run_code
playwrightTools.description: Run Playwright code snippet

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

playwrightTools.name: browser_take_screenshot
playwrightTools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

playwrightTools.name: browser_snapshot
playwrightTools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file instead of returning it in the response.

playwrightTools.name: browser_click
playwrightTools.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

playwrightTools.name: browser_drag
playwrightTools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startRef.description: Exact source element reference from the page snapshot

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endRef.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

playwrightTools.name: browser_hover
playwrightTools.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

playwrightTools.name: browser_select_option
playwrightTools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

playwrightTools.name: browser_generate_locator
playwrightTools.description: Generate locator for the given element to use in tests

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

playwrightTools.name: browser_tabs
playwrightTools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

playwrightTools.name: browser_start_tracing
playwrightTools.description: Start trace recording

playwrightTools.name: browser_stop_tracing
playwrightTools.description: Stop trace recording

playwrightTools.name: browser_wait_for
playwrightTools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

playwrightTools.name: browser_verify_element_visible
playwrightTools.description: Verify element is visible on the page

role.description: ROLE of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- {ROLE} "Accessible Name":`

accessibleName.description: ACCESSIBLE_NAME of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}"`

playwrightTools.name: browser_verify_text_visible
playwrightTools.description: Verify text is visible on the page. Prefer browser_verify_element_visible if possible.

text.description: TEXT to verify. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "Accessible Name": {TEXT}` or like this: `- text: {TEXT}`

playwrightTools.name: browser_verify_list_visible
playwrightTools.description: Verify list is visible on the page

ref.description: Exact target element reference that points to the list

playwrightTools.name: browser_verify_value
playwrightTools.description: Verify element value

ref.description: Exact target element reference that points to the element

value.description: Value to verify. For checkbox, use "true" or "false".
